title: Outlander
html:
Outlander is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around exploration and navigating the wilds. Karlach, Halsin, and the hirelings Eldra Luthrinn and Sina'zith have this background.

“
You grew up in the wilds, learning to survive far from the comforts of civilisation. Surviving unusual hazards of the wild will enhance your prowess and understanding.
„

Background features

  • Athletics Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with Strength (Athletics) Ability Checks.
  • Survival Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with Wisdom (Survival) Ability Checks.

Background goals

Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration. These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points.

Location XP Reward Name Description
Act 1
Multiple locations 30 Walking On Air Successfully use a fairy ring.
  • "Fairy ring" refers to the mushroom circles found in the Sunlit Wetlands, in the Overgrown Tunnel or in the Underdark.
Campsite 25 Cub Tamer Successfully tame the owlbear cub.
  • The inspiration is given after the cub comes to the camp for the second time and if then stays as a follower.
Grymforge 50 The Floor Is Lava Defeat the Lava Elemental in the lava lake.
Forest 25 A Mother's Fury Triumph over the mother Owlbear.
  • Does not require actually fighting the Owlbear. Convincing her not to attack using Speak with Animals is sufficient.
Risen Road 30 Rock Steady Survive the bandit's rolling boulder trap.
  • The trap blocks the cave mouth at X: 50 Y: 570.
  • The description is misleading; disarming or getting around the two tripwire traps awards the inspiration, while getting hit by the boulder and surviving does not.
30 Cursebreaker Discover the curse of Yeenoghu and destroy his hyenas.
  • The nearby gnolls must also be killed.
Sunlit Wetlands 30 Eyes of the Wild See past the illusion covering the swamp.
Underdark 30 A Noble Endeavour Effectively use a noblestalk mushroom.
  • This can be accomplished by giving the mushroom to Derryth, Shadowheart, or Baelen, or by The Dark Urge using it themselves.
30 Abyss Jumper The party must enter the Underdark through the bottomless well.
  • Feather Fall effects, via spell or potion, can be used to survive the fall.
  • This can be acquired even if the Underdark was previously entered via some other way.
30 Clever Cuckoo Steal from the giant bird's nest in the Underdark.
  • The nest can be reaced by series of jumps up from X: 43 Y: -141. The chest inside can be looted freely.
30 Mushroom Enthusiast Destroy each kind of hazardous Underdark mushroom.
  • The party must destroy at least one stalk of Bibberbangs, Timmasks and Torchstalks, regardless of the order. Nightlights and Barrelstalks do not count.
  • The inspiration is given regardless of whether any party member got hurt from the mushrooms' effects.
30 Nest Egg Take an item from the Carrion Crawler nest.
  • The inspiration is awarded only after the passive  DC 15 Survival Check, which, in turn, is available only to Short races, e.g. Halfling, Dwarf or Gnome.
Wilderness 20 Sticky Fingers Secure the pouch from the spider crevice.
Act 2
Gauntlet of Shar 75 Always a Step Ahead of the Darkness Reach Nightsong without having been affected by the shadow curse.
  • This is not granted when you reach Nightsong, but when you come back from the Shadowfell.
75 Path Least Followed Complete the Gauntlet of Shar without going to Last Light or Moonrise.
75 Tools of the Trade Obtain the orthon's crossbow.
Last Light Inn 60 Grove Keeper's Keeper Protect Halsin's portal while he saves the spirit of the land.
Mind Flayer Colony 95 From Head to Toe Explore all sections of the mind flayer colony.
  • This is awarded upon following Ketheric to the lower level.
Moonrise Towers 50 Delving into the Deep Enter the oubliette... for better or for worse.
50 Mutual Respect Meet Steelclaw the tadpole-hunting cat.
60 Never Liked Stairs Enter a restricted area in Moonrise Towers from the outside.

It can be one of the following rooms:

  • Isobel's room
  • Ketheric's chambers
  • Balthazar's lab
Reithwin Town 60 I've Had Worse Successfully drink and resist the negative effects of the brewer's concoction.
  • It is not necessary for the Outlander to actually do this; they just need to be present when someone does.
Shadow-Cursed Lands 60 Bumps in the Dark Conquer three combat encounters in the Shadow-Cursed Lands.
50 Child's Play Beat Oliver at hide and seek without alerting the shadow creatures.
  • This requires winning both rounds of Oliver's game.
50 Embracing the Environment Survive two rounds of the shadow curse.
  • The inspiration is given at the start of the third turn, if the character feeling the curse effect is still alive and not downed. It does not need to be the character with the Outlander background themselves.
60 I Ain't Afraid of No Shadows Traverse through the Shadow-Cursed Lands to Last Light and Moonrise without using a Moonlantern.
60 No Cursed Stone Left Unturned Explore each key area of the Shadow-Cursed Lands.
  • The party must visit the Ruined Battlefield, Reithwin Town, the Last Light Inn, and reach the Gauntlet of Shar (through the Grand Mausoleum). The inspiration is given upon entering the last of all four locations, regardless of the order. Thorough exploration is not needed.
50 Sleeping in the Dark Take a full Long Rest in the Shadow-Cursed Lands.
  • This is only awarded for resting in a camp that's out in the actual dangerous area. Camping at Last Light Inn, in Moonrise Towers, or in the Gauntlet of Shar[1] does not count.
Act 3
Iron Throne 220 Down to the Depths Below Enter the Iron Throne.
  • The inspiration is given upon docking the submersible at the underwater prison.
House of Hope 220 Horizon Walker Travel through the House of Hope portal.
  • The inspiration is given upon arrival.
  • Shared with ⁠An Exotic Charter inspiration.
Lower City 220 Catastrophic Structural Failure Blow up the Steel Watch Foundry.
170 Children of an Outlander Convince Jaheira to let her family stay in the city.
  • Shared with ⁠Cherishing Family inspiration.
170 For Once, a Warm Meal Obtain room and board at the Elfsong Tavern.
  • Shared with ⁠Proper Lodging, Finally, ⁠Veteran's Hotspot, and ⁠Perks of the Trade inspirations (the latter if a discount was gained).
170 Nature of the Beast Discover the fate of the Githyanki egg.
170 Urban Jungle Survive the Bhaalist ambush at the park.
Rivington 135 Cat's Got Your Tongue? Find the missing letters.
  • Shared with ⁠Interrupted Communications inspiration.
135 Enlisted Avian Meet Commander Lightfeather.
  • Shared with ⁠Reporting for Duty inspiration.
135 Gifts of the Wilds Give raw goods as a donation.
  • Shared with ⁠Food for the Soul inspiration.
170 Macabre Hunt Find all the pieces of Dribbles' body and return them to Lucretious.
170 Primary Needs Tame the dilophosaurus, making it non-hostile.
  • Mutually exclusive with the ⁠Running Wild inspiration.
135 Running Wild Release all the imprisoned circus beasts.
  • Mutually exclusive with the ⁠Primary Needs inspiration.
  • If Crimson is fed before unlocking his cage, he does not run away, and the inspiration cannot be gained.
135 Solemn Farewell Witness the Gur funeral.
  • Available only if Astarion was not betrayed to the Gur hunter in Act One.
  • Shared with ⁠Skald's Song inspiration.
Undercity 170 Beneath the Gate Enter the Undercellar.
  • Shared with ⁠Friends in Low Places and ⁠Underbelly Diplomat inspirations.
220 The Face of Evil Reach the Temple of Bhaal.
  • Shared with ⁠Forgotten, Bloodied, Halls and ⁠Homecoming inspirations.

Notes and References

  1. ↑ The area free of the curse starts in approximately 3 m (10 ft) from the hidden door leading to the Gauntlet from the Grand Mausoleum. Moving to the campsite before this imaginary line leads to the primary Shadow-Cursed Lands' campsite layout and allows to earn the inspiration.
